the immobilization of the drug-loaded polymeric coatings onto Ti implants can offer a sustained drug release with no burst release and maintain a therapeutic concentration for a longer period, so it is an effective strategy to prevent and treat bone infections.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of a drug-eluting implant for local antibiotic delivery.
the design of a vancomycin-loaded hydrogel coating for the treatment and prevention of local bone infections.
the immobilization of vancomycin-loaded polymeric coatings onto Ti implants for the local delivery of antibiotics and the prevention of infections in orthopaedics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the vancomycin-loaded hydrogel film on the Ti implant can provide a sustained drug delivery and reduce the inflammatory reaction, which is beneficial to the treatment and prevention of bone infections.
the antibiotic-loaded poly(ethylene glycols) (PEGs) based hydrogel coatings on Ti implants could be used for local delivery of vancomycin to treat and prevent bone infections.
the immobilization of antibiotic loaded polymeric coatings on the surface of osteoarticular titanium implants can be a potential approach to prevent and treat implant-associated infections.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the vancomycin-loaded hydrogel film with a PEG-PLC membrane was covalently immobilized on Ti implants to prevent implant-associated bone infections, and the release behavior and the antimicrobial effect were evaluated in vitro and in vivo.
a vancomycin-loaded poly(ethylene glyco)-based hydrogel coating on Ti implants can be used to prevent and treat local bone infections.
the vancomycin-loaded polymeric coatings can be immobilized on Ti implants to achieve a sustained antibiotic release and thus prevent bone infections.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the immobilization of drug-loaded hydrogel coatings on Ti implants can be used for the prevention of implant-associated infections.
the vancomycin-loaded PEG-PLCL/PEG hydrogel coating on Ti implants can be an effective and safe strategy for preventing implant-associated infections.
vancomycin-loaded polymeric coating can provide an extended and sustained release of antibiotics, which is a promising approach to treat bone infections.
